text:
maya: Quick sync — weekly GPU headroom snapshot attached. Short asks: (1) confirm EU‑W egress/peering impact, (2) sign off on cost-smoothing window shift to reduce spot churn, (3) sign up for canary of autoscaler tweak. TL;DR: global headroom ~12% but eu-west drops to ~3% after peering maintenance; US-W and APAC have room. See numbers below.

deploy-bot: capacity-query v2 finished (run_id=cap-3610004000). Baseline metrics: total provisioned GPUs=1,820, effective headroom=12.1%, current spot mix=22%.

jon: Copy — thanks. EU‑W at 3% is pretty tight. Which clusters in eu-west are the biggest contributors?

maya: eu-west breakdown (24h runrate snapshot):
```
eu-west-1:
  cluster-gamma: 48 GPUs - runrate 432 GPU-hrs/day - headroom 2.5%
  cluster-theia: 32 GPUs - runrate 288 GPU-hrs/day - headroom 3.8%
  cluster-orion: 16 GPUs - runrate 144 GPU-hrs/day - headroom 1.2%  <-- customer-sustained embeddings
```
Main callouts: cluster-orion is tight due to customer X embeddings and cross-region fallbacks to eu-west.

liam: Noted. We've seen a ~35% uplift in embeddings traffic from customer X over last 72h; most of that lands on orion because of affinity rules. Suggest routing their heavy embedding flows to a dedicated shard or to APAC edge where headroom exists.

sarah: For autoscaler: proposal is to temporarily lower min_preemptible in eu-west from 6 -> 2 and raise reserved_on_demand by 4 for 48h during peering maintenance. That keeps on-demand runway but reduces spot churn/cost. Risk: increases on-demand spend ~+$1.1k/day but avoids availability risk from spot preemptions.

nina (Finance): From a cost POV, cost-smoothing window looks attractive. If we increase tolerated spot mix by +10% across non-latency clusters, estimated savings ~ $12k/month. But we need SLO guardrails and rollback triggers before we touch production.

jon: Agree with nina — we need automatic rollback if p99 latency > target for 10m. I'll own the canary and rollback hooks. Proposed canary schedule: tomorrow 02:00–04:00 UTC (low-traffic window).

liam: I'll prepare eval prompts and perf checks for embeddings quality/latency. Quick checklist: (a) sample prompt set for customer X, (b) generate 2000 combined requests, (c) compare latency and token loss metrics.

sarah: I'll open INF ticket and add runbook entries. Ticket: INF-8427 (eu-west autoscale tweak + peering mitigation). Will include the autoscaler config diff and canary playbook.

maya: Action items summary: jon -> run canary + rollback hook; sarah -> open INF-8427 + runbook; liam -> perf eval set; nina -> approve cost-smoothing with finance guardrails. If all thumbs up, we'll apply change during canary and assess 2h after. Please react with :thumbsup: if you sign off.

jon: I'll take the canary. +:thumbsup: Scheduled 02:00 UTC.

liam: +1 — prepping evals now.

nina (Finance): +1 conditional on rollback triggers in place.

maya: Thanks — I'll update the runway doc and post a short readout in Friday AM ops review. Will also add a note about temporary on-demand delta and expected cost delta. :thumbsup:
